footnote_text: Disposed of pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of August 2, 2026, by and among the issuer, Armstrong Parent, Inc., and Armstrong Bidco, Inc. (the "Merger Agreement"). || Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, (i) each share of common stock of the issuer, par value $0.001 per share ("Issuer Common Stock"), held by the reporting person was converted into the right to receive $127 in cash, without interest (the "Merger Consideration"), (ii) as a result of the reporting person's departure from the board of directors of the issuer at the effective time of the transactions contemplated by the Merger Agreement, each restricted stock unit held by the reporting person was canceled and converted into the right to receive a cash amount equal to the Merger Consideration and (iii) each stock option held by the reporting person was canceled and converted into the right to receive a cash amount equal to (x) the excess of the Merger Consideration over the applicable exercise price applicable to such stock option, multiplied by (y) the number of shares of Issuer Common Stock subject to such stock option.
